14bd157cfa5e.title_issue: 용출 실패 조사 지연·공정 관리 미흡
14bd157cfa5e.hook_line: 2021년 용출 저하 징후에도 2025년 3월 기준일탈 뒤에야 조사 시작
14bd157cfa5e.summary: FDA가 인도 제조소 Alkem Laboratories Limited에 경고서한을 발행했다. 용출 시험 결과와 불만 조사 미흡, 생산·공정 관리 절차, 설비 세척·유지관리 등 위반 3건을 지적했다.
key_facts: 위반 1: 불일치·규격 불합격을 철저히 조사하지 않음 — 용출 저하 징후를 2025년 3월 기준일탈(OOS)이 나올 때까지 조사하지 않음, 정제 파손 불만 약 38건 조사 미흡(21 CFR 211.192)
위반 2: 정제 공정 변수를 과학적 근거 없이 정하거나 바꿔 공정이 관리 상태가 아님(21 CFR 211.100(a))
위반 3: 설비 세척·유지관리 절차를 수립·준수하지 않음(21 CFR 211.67(b))
당국 조치: 위반 해결 때까지 신규 신청 승인 보류 가능, 미국 반입 거부 가능, 15영업일 안에 서면 회신 요구
14bd157cfa5e.implication: 회사는 해당 배치가 2025년 8월 6개월 안정성 시점에야 기준일탈에 이르렀다고 회신했으나, FDA는 출시 제품 전반의 관련 품질 경향을 찾고 조사하지 못한 점을 설명하지 못한다며 받아들이지 않았다(위반 1). 회사는 2024년 7월부터 2025년 8월까지 미국 시장용으로 제조한 배치에 회수를 포함한 시장 조치를 했다(위반 1). 시정 및 예방조치(CAPA) 시행 뒤에도 정제 파손 불만이 계속 들어왔고, 현장 경보 보고서는 실사가 시작된 뒤에야 제출됐다(위반 1). 회사는 공정 변수 규격이 과학 기반 시험이 아니라 과거 경향 자료에서 나왔다고 인정했다(위반 2). 회사는 해당 정제의 미국 시장용 생산을 일시 중단하기로 약속했다.
checks: 새 공급업체 원료를 도입할 때 완제품 용출에 주는 영향을 평가하는가? (위반 1)
제품 불만에 대한 CAPA 뒤 같은 불만이 재발하는지 추적하는가? (위반 1)
공정 변수 범위를 바꿀 때 과학적 근거를 문서로 남기는가? (위반 2)

en.hook_line: Investigation began only after failing dissolution results in March 2025
en.summary: FDA issued a warning letter to the Indian manufacturing site of Alkem Laboratories Limited, citing three violations including inadequate investigation of dissolution results and complaints, production and process control procedures, and equipment cleaning and maintenance.
key_facts: Violation 1: unexplained discrepancies and failures not thoroughly investigated; no investigation of dissolution signals until OOS results in March 2025, and inadequate investigation of approximately 38 broken tablet complaints (21 CFR 211.192)
Violation 2: tablet process parameters set or changed without scientific justification, so the process is not in a state of control (21 CFR 211.100(a))
Violation 3: written procedures for equipment cleaning and maintenance not established and followed (21 CFR 211.67(b))
Agency action: FDA may withhold approval of new applications and refuse admission of articles; written response requested within fifteen business days
en.implication: The firm responded that the batch did not reach the OOS threshold until the six-month stability interval in August 2025, but FDA found the response inadequate because it does not account for the failure to identify and investigate related quality trends (Violation 1). The firm took market action, including recalls, on batches made from July 2024 to August 2025 for the U.S. market (Violation 1). Complaints for broken tablets continued after the CAPAs, and a FAR was not submitted until after the inspection started (Violation 1). The firm acknowledged its process specifications were derived from historical trend data rather than science-based studies (Violation 2). The firm committed to temporarily suspend production of the tablets for the U.S. market.
checks: Is the impact of new supplier excipients on finished product dissolution evaluated? (Violation 1)
Is recurrence of the same complaint tracked after a CAPA? (Violation 1)
Is scientific justification documented when process parameter ranges change? (Violation 2)

en.title_issue: GMP approval revoked for falsified records
en.hook_line: Shipped as conforming while sterility tests were still running; GMP approval revoked
en.summary: MFDS revoked the GMP conformity approval of a manufacturer that manufactured differently from its license and repeatedly falsified batch manufacturing records, test logs and certificates of analysis.
key_facts: Violation: a cefotetan product was made as one batch by mixing leftover packaged product and materials without batch records, and the batch manufacturing record was repeatedly falsified

Violation: for 6 products including a cefotiam hydrochloride product, test dates and results were falsified while sterility tests were ongoing, and certificates of analysis were marked conforming before shipment
Sanction: revocation of the GMP conformity approval (effective 2026-12-08) for cephalosporin products (synthetic sterile and non-sterile)
Basis: Pharmaceutical Affairs Act Article 38-3(1) and (3)2
en.implication: Certificates of analysis were marked conforming and shipments proceeded although sterility test results had not been confirmed. The disposition notice states the falsification was repeated.
checks: Does your system block approval of a certificate of analysis before sterility testing ends?
Are leftover packaged product and undocumented materials prevented from entering a batch?
Are test log start and end dates checked against raw data?

en.implication: The on-site inspection ran from 2026-02-11 to 2026-02-13 (3 days). 'Other' findings are to be corrected, and a GMP certificate is issued once the implementation plan is confirmed as appropriate.
checks: Is the person performing a test different from the person reviewing and approving it? (Finding 1)
Even at small sites, is a separate reviewer and approver of test results designated? (Finding 1)

recall-dfe247bc36de.summary: 알림타액상주25밀리그램/밀리리터(페메트렉시드이나트륨염칠수화물)가 시판 후 안정성 시험(유연물질) 기준 초과 우려에 따른 사전 예방적 영업자 회수로 회수됐다.
key_facts: 사유: 시판 후 안정성 시험(유연물질) 기준 초과 우려에 따른 사전 예방적 조치
제품·범위: 알림타액상주25밀리그램/밀리리터(페메트렉시드이나트륨염칠수화물)
구분: 영업자 회수

en.hook_line: A pemetrexed injection recalled as a precaution over post-marketing stability results
en.summary: A pemetrexed 25 mg/mL injection product was recalled as a precaution over concern that related substances in post-marketing stability testing would exceed the limit (voluntary recall by the company).
key_facts: Reason: precaution over concern of related substances exceeding the limit in post-marketing stability testing
Product and scope: one pemetrexed 25 mg/mL injection product
Type: voluntary recall by the company

D-0156-2027.hook_line: 메토헥시탈 500 mg 바이알, 셀룰로스 입자로 Class I 회수
D-0156-2027.summary: Brevital Sodium(메토헥시탈나트륨) 주사용 500 mg 바이알이 입자 존재로 회수됐다(Class I). 입자는 셀룰로스로 확인됐다.
key_facts: 사유: 입자 존재 — 셀룰로스로 확인
제품·범위: Brevital Sodium (Methohexital Sodium), For Injection, USP, 500 mg/vial
등급: Class I

en.hook_line: Methohexital 500 mg vials recalled after particulates identified as cellulose (Class I)
en.summary: Brevital Sodium (methohexital sodium) for injection, 500 mg/vial, was recalled for the presence of particulate matter identified as cellulose (Class I).
key_facts: Reason: presence of particulate matter; particulates identified as cellulose
Product and scope: Brevital Sodium (Methohexital Sodium), For Injection, USP, 500 mg/vial
Class: Class I

D-0189-2027.hook_line: 히알루론산 캡슐에서 덱사메타손 등 미표시 성분, Class I 회수
D-0189-2027.summary: UMARY Acido Hialuronico 캡슐이 승인 없이 판매됐고 FDA 시험에서 미표시 성분이 검출돼 회수됐다(Class I).
key_facts: 사유: 승인된 NDA/ANDA 없이 판매, FDA 시험에서 미표시 성분 덱사메타손·디클로페낙·오메프라졸 검출
제품·범위: UMARY Acido Hialuronico(New Hyaluronic Acid 850mg Sealed 30 Caps)
등급: Class I
quotes_translation: 승인된 NDA/ANDA 없이 판매됨 - FDA 시험실 분석에서 제품에 미표시 성분인 덱사메타손, 디클로페낙, 오메프라졸이 섞인 것으로 확인됨.

en.hook_line: Hyaluronic acid capsules found with undeclared dexamethasone and other drugs (Class I)
en.summary: UMARY Acido Hialuronico capsules were recalled after being marketed without approval and found by FDA analysis to contain undeclared ingredients (Class I).
key_facts: Reason: marketed without approved NDA/ANDA; FDA analysis found undeclared dexamethasone, diclofenac and omeprazole
Product and scope: UMARY Acido Hialuronico (New Hyaluronic Acid 850mg Sealed 30 Caps)
Class: Class I

D-0192-2027.hook_line: 테스토스테론 30 mL 바이알, 무균성 보증 부족 Class II 회수
D-0192-2027.summary: 테스토스테론 시피오네이트/테스토스테론 프로피오네이트 200/10 mg/mL 30 mL 바이알이 무균성 보증 부족으로 회수됐다(Class II).
key_facts: 사유: 무균성 보증 부족
제품·범위: Testosterone Cypionate / Testosterone Propionate 200/10 mg/mL, 30mL vials
등급: Class II

en.title_issue: Recall for lack of sterility assurance
en.hook_line: Testosterone 200/10 mg/mL 30 mL vials recalled for lack of sterility assurance (Class II)
en.summary: Testosterone cypionate/testosterone propionate 200/10 mg/mL 30 mL vials were recalled for lack of sterility assurance (Class II).
key_facts: Reason: lack of sterility assurance
Product and scope: Testosterone Cypionate / Testosterone Propionate 200/10 mg/mL, 30mL vials
Class: Class II
